name: Kirana store
intro: If you run a kirana store and give goods on udhar to regular customers, you need to remember who took what, and when they paid. BolCash is made to keep these records on your phone.

uses.title: Customer udhar
uses.body: Note down the udhar each customer takes. Mark it when they pay.

uses.title: Supplier dues
uses.body: Keep track of what you owe your wholesalers and distributors, and note it when you pay.

uses.title: Daily cash
uses.body: Record the money that comes in and goes out each day.
